# Press A's Settings tab, its Health section drawn from /api/processes/1/catid-health: one item of each
# kind that carries a verb (S4: the items open inside the process). Each act on a fresh tab.
## Settings' Health: Start changeover to Style B (one tap, no sheet)
  1  POST /api/processes/1/changeover/start
       {
         "to_style_id": 2,
         "called_by": "engineer",
         "notes": "from the health strip: the PLC is on its part"
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed

## Pin to Style B (the suggestion), then the sheet's Pin
  1  POST /api/processes/1/styles/2/catid
       {
         "catid": "CAT-Q",
         "evidence": "the health strip"
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed

## the chooser's Pin, on its first option (Style A), then the sheet's Pin
  1  POST /api/processes/1/styles/1/catid
       {
         "catid": "CAT-Q",
         "evidence": "the health strip"
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed

## Count Slot2, then the sheet's Count
  1  POST /api/processes/1/counter
       {
         "tag_name": "MES.Slot2"
       }
  2  GET /api/processes
  3  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  4  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed

## Charge: its preview, then the sheet's Charge
  1  POST /api/catid-holds/41/charge?mode=preview
  2  POST /api/catid-holds/41/charge?mode=charge
       {}
  3  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed

## Write off, then the sheet's Write off
  1  POST /api/catid-holds/41/write-off
       {}
  2  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed
